notes: Improved feature panel with better styling and comments support. Added initial user panel. Spell checker can now be changed from the editor under bar. Improvements to worldbuilding category viewer with auto-updating character and worldbuilding trees. Fixed invisible text selection. Fixed undo/redo issues. Timer is now visible. AI features can be hidden. Improved distraction-free mode. Added autosave. Image support has entered testing stage.

release_notes.en:
Improved feature panel with better styling and comments support
Added initial version of the user panel
Spell checker can be changed from the editor under bar
Improvements to the worldbuilding category viewer
Character and worldbuilding trees now auto-update after modifications
Fixed text selection not being visible
Fixed issues with undo and redo
Timer is now visible
AI features can be hidden
Distraction-free mode improved
Added autosave function
Image support has entered testing stage
